think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/auto/special mode) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) Determine whether such a sentinel breaks the natural numeric ordering by switching the feature into a qualitatively different mode. 4) If a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
